patch_description: The recommendation identifies bidirectional Kalman fusion as the only untested structural addition that was never implicated in prior failures. I preserve the champion cascade (adaptive-Q Kalman → robust SG → recency convolution → median snap) and add a single structural mutation at Stage 1: run the adaptive-Q Kalman both forward and on the time-reversed input, then fuse the two estimates 50/50. The forward pass has zero phase lag at the start but accumulates endpoint-phase error; the backward pass has the opposite bias; averaging cancels much of the interior phase error, potentially lifting tracking accuracy while leaving the downstream smoothness stages untouched. All previously failed paradigms (slope-domain rewriting, endpoint regression, sign-locking) are avoided.
